The '''''Endeavor''''' was a colony [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] operated by the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], it was carrying 100 individuals to a new [[Planet/Legends|world]]. It was waylaid and captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]], who had fled the Empire and established an [[Rezi Soresh's outpost|outpost]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Soresh took the hostages to his outpost on a [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to use as bait in a trap for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] by threatening the hostages' lives.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

When Skywalker arrived, Soresh used an [[Rezi Soresh (impostor)|impostor]] to greet him. The impostor was [[Death/Legends|blasted]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], Skywalker's ally. Skywalker and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|compatriots]] moved to the compound to free the hostages, but a series of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] went off, causing chaos. A colonist who appeared wounded grabbed Skywalker and used a [[Force pike/Legends|Force pike]] to subdue Skywalker and revealed himself as Soresh. Soresh captured the other Rebels and held them in his outpost as he attempted to [[Project Omega|brainwash]] Skywalker. Soresh was also planning on luring the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Fleet]] to his moon, along with Imperial leader [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and destroying those obstacles to his power. Using his resources, Soresh acquired [[resonance torpedo]]es to destroy the [[Sixela system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|star]].<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

As the fleets [[Battle of the Sixela system|arrived]], Skywalker betrayed Soresh and his drugged bodyguards. Soresh escaped, but not before launching the resonance torpedoes. As the star began its death throes, the fleets withdrew, allowing Skywalker and his companions to rescue the surviving hostages. The hostages escaped on their ship before the supernova struck.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
The vessel's name and origin were established in its appearance in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''. During the narrative, the colonists were not specifically identified as Arkanian, but were instead referred to simply as "men" and "women." The ship was also mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />
